bullets.text: MTD Misunderstandings Unveiled - Misconceptions about Making Tax Digital for Income Tax could lead to compliance issues for many UK taxpayers.
Interactive MTD Checklist - A click-to-tick checklist simplifies MTD for Income Tax, ensuring compliance ahead of the April 2026 deadline.

Sage Copilot: AI for Finance - **Sage Copilot** enhances finance operations with AI, ensuring security and efficiency in data handling.
